The adjacent `stress-sample.svg` preserves the original, identical media/effects
sample from the deleted HTML/CSS stress websites. It was recovered byte-for-byte
from `build/website-archive-20261001/browser/html-css-stress-media/sample.svg`
during the 2026-10-02 audit. `run-svg-tests.cjs` uses it for both embedded-media
and HTML-filter regression cases. Historical CSS remains in
`website-regressions.json`. These fixtures are not served as public demo pages.
